subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB1012
title: Requires a health care practitioner to exercise the proper degree of care to preserve the health and life of a child born alive, regardless of whether the birth was the result of an induced abortion.
headline: SB 1012 did not pass

claims.text: SB 1012 was introduced in the Senate on February 11, 2025.
SB 1012 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
